payload.title: The post-merge scan lists only the last 20 merged PRs repo-wide and, since F3.4, credits a PR only when merge_record already holds its merged row, so an ARIA merge classified late or reached after 20 other merges never gets a merge outcome and nothing rescans older merges, which blinds the post-merge red trigger and the landed-revert check
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/own_pr_ci.py:206-211 (a PR outside arias_merges is skipped before any outcome row)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/github_adapters.py:550-566 (list_merged_own_prs: gh pr list --state merged --limit N, not filtered to ARIA)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle.py:1672-1676 (the cycle calls the scan with the default limit)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/implementation_reconciler.py:120-130 (an unreadable merged head is retried, so the merged row can arrive cycles after the merge)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/self_revert.py:644-657 (post-merge candidates come only from the merge-outcome rows)
payload.rule_violated: ARIA-HIGH-199 / ORPHAN-718 intent: every ARIA merge is watched for a red on main and reverted when attributable; a safety net must not depend on how many unrelated PRs merged in between.
payload.notes: A person merges an ARIA PR; merge_record cannot read the merged head and retries for up to six cycles, or ARIA is paused for days while other sessions merge more than 20 PRs. By the time the lineage is classified the PR is no longer among the 20 newest merged PRs, so scan_merged_own_prs never lists it, no merge-outcome row is written, the post-merge candidate list never contains it, and a red that main shows after it is never attributed or reverted by the post-merge CI trigger (the change-outcome regression trigger reads the merged rows directly and is not affected). The 20-PR window existed before F3.4; F3.4 added a second condition that is satisfied after the merge. Close condition: Drive the scan from the merged rows merge_record holds (arias_merges) and ask GitHub for each PR's merge commit by number (the per-PR read the reconciler already uses, reader.pr_merge_state), instead of listing the repository's last N merges; a test with a merged row whose PR is outside the newest 20 asserts a merge-outcome row is still written. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
